title.en: Character.AI launches — and millions start talking to AI companions
title.zhHans: Character.AI 上线，数百万人开始与 AI 伴侣对话

summary.en: In September 2022, Character.AI launched — a platform where users could chat with AI personas of real and fictional characters. Within a year it reached 20 million users, with an average daily engagement of two hours. Character.AI pioneered the AI companion category, creating a new form of human-AI interaction centered on emotional connection and entertainment rather than productivity.
summary.zhHans: 2022 年 9 月，Character.AI 上线——一个用户可以与真实和虚构角色的 AI 人格聊天的平台。一年内达到 2000 万用户，日均使用时长达到两小时。Character.AI 开创了 AI 陪伴品类，创造了一种以情感连接和娱乐而非生产力为中心的人机交互新形式。

narrative.en: Character.AI was founded by Noam Shazeer and Daniel De Freitas — two former Google engineers who had co-authored the foundational 'Attention Is All You Need' paper that introduced the Transformer architecture. Their thesis was that conversational AI should not be limited to productivity assistants but could be a new form of entertainment and companionship. The platform let users create or choose from millions of AI characters — historical figures, fictional characters, celebrities, or original creations — and engage in open-ended text conversations. By May 2023, Character.AI had 20 million registered users, with average engagement of two hours per day — far exceeding social media platforms. The most popular characters ranged from therapy bots to roleplay partners to digital versions of famous people. Character.AI became a cultural phenomenon, especially among younger users who formed genuine emotional attachments to their AI companions. The platform raised nearly $200 million from Andreessen Horowitz at a $1 billion valuation by March 2023. The success of Character.AI sparked the broader AI companion industry — competitors like Replika, Anima, and later OpenAI's 'GPTs' all followed the model of creating personalized AI interaction partners that users could form ongoing relationships with. The platform also raised difficult questions about AI relationships, parasocial attachment, and the ethics of creating emotional bonds with AI systems — questions that became central to the broader AI safety conversation.
narrative.zhHans: Character.AI 由 Noam Shazeer 和 Daniel De Freitas 创立——两位前 Google 工程师，他们共同撰写了奠定 Transformer 架构的基础论文《Attention Is All You Need》。他们的论点是对话式 AI 不应限于生产力助手，而可以成为一种新的娱乐和陪伴形式。该平台让用户创建或选择数百万个 AI 角色——历史人物、虚构角色、名人或原创角色——并进行开放式文本对话。到 2023 年 5 月，Character.AI 拥有 2000 万注册用户，日均使用时长两小时——远超社交媒体平台。最受欢迎的角色从治疗机器人到角色扮演伙伴，再到名人的数字版本。Character.AI 成为一种文化现象，尤其是在年轻用户中，他们与自己的 AI 陪伴建立了真正的情感依恋。到 2023 年 3 月，该平台从 Andreessen Horowitz 获得了近 2 亿美元融资，估值 10 亿美元。Character.AI 的成功引发了更广泛的 AI 陪伴行业——Replika、Anima 等竞争对手，以及后来的 OpenAI"GPTs" 都效仿了这一模式：创建用户可以与之建立持续关系的个性化 AI 交互伙伴。该平台也引发了关于 AI 关系、寄生情感依恋以及与 AI 系统建立情感纽带的伦理等棘手问题——这些问题后来成为更广泛的 AI 安全讨论的核心。

description.en: Created the AI companion category. 20M users with 2hr daily average engagement. Shifted perception of AI from productivity tool to emotional/entertainment partner. Spawned an industry of AI companion platforms.
